get.description: Returns a paginated, filterable, sortable list of alerts. Supports filtering by state, processDefinitionId, and creation time range.

parameters.name: processDefinitionId
parameters.description: Filter by process definition ID (stored in alert metadata)

parameters.name: createdFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound for createdAt (ISO-8601 instant, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

parameters.name: createdTo
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound for createdAt (ISO-8601 instant)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field with direction prefix: +field (ASC) or -field (DESC). Allowed fields: count, createdAt, updatedAt, severity, state

get.description: Returns aggregated stats of all FIRING alerts grouped by processDefinitionId and version. The totalCount is the sum of each alert's count within that group.
Returns a paginated list of alerts matching any of the provided states.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: One or more alert states to filter by

AlertResponse.description: Representation of a persistent telemetry alert

source.description: System or service that raised the alert

alertKey.description: Deduplication key scoped to the source

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the alert

count.description: Number of times this alert has been raised (re-fired)

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the alert (e.g. processDefinitionId, processInstanceId)

resendIntervalMs.description: Per-alert resend interval override in milliseconds

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the alert was first created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this alert

lastTriggeredAt.description: Timestamp when a notification was last sent for this alert

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the alert was resolved (null if not resolved)

acknowledgedAt.description: Timestamp when the alert was acknowledged

acknowledgedBy.description: Identity of the actor who acknowledged the alert

silencedAt.description: Timestamp when the alert was silenced

silencedBy.description: Identity of the actor who silenced the alert

ActorRequest.description: Request body identifying the actor performing an action

actor.description: Identity of the user or system performing the action

content.description: List of alerts for the current page

totalElements.description: Total number of alerts matching the filter criteria
